honest_c3: C1 mac CPU fp32 — numerical noise floor low; argmax tie-breaking is deterministic but a different vocab id at same logit can flip text.

C2 ln_f bypass invalidates head_a's training-time normalized-input expectation. If head_a was trained POST-RMSNorm only, applying it to PRE-ln_f hidden is an out-of-distribution probe — incoherent output does not isolate basin pathology.
C3 single prompt long-Korean — anecdotal. Per-prompt variance not measured; cannot generalize to 'basin everywhere' from one input.

C4 BG-AR insight — per-layer hidden-state NORM trajectory does NOT establish semantic content recovery. A high-norm intermediate layer can still encode a degenerate distribution that maps to byte-fallback under any head.

C5 'semi_coherent' heuristic anima-internal: ≥5 Korean+ASCII chars and no single char >50% of text. False-positive on valid mixed-script garbage; false-negative on short coherent fragments. Verdict label is informative not authoritative.
